text: This has to be the worst McDonald's on the planet, the general ambiance and cleanliness isn't too bad but the service is simply atrocious. I've lived in this area a year now and never once had an order 100% correct, must be over 20 orders now and ALWAYS at least 1 thing or more wrong, from entire meals missing to drinks or desserts, it's ludicrous. Even when you order via apps such as UberEats or Glovo they still get your order wrong!! I've ordered from McDonald's in China where they couldn't understand a word of English and the menu was written in Mandarin and still got the order correct, how the staff so consistently fail here is beyond me. Even when the store is empty and you're the only customer being served they'll still get your order wrong.
author: Thomas William Crabtree (Thomas)

text: The WORST experience. They completely ignored me and never took my order. There were two queues, so I was in one of them, waiting to be served. When it was finally my turn, I was ready to order, but the staff just ignored me and walked away. I then moved to the other queue, and when my turn came again, another staff member walked away to serve the other queue, taking everyone else's order but mine. Later, they giggled and said something in Spanish, which I couldn’t understand. As the only Asian in the queues, I felt that this was totally RACIST. Being ignored while waiting to be served is the most typical act of racism that Asians often experience in Europe.
author: Seonmi Kim

text: It was the worst experience ever! The synthetic flavour of our burgers is terrible, everything tasted like plastic. I can’t believe Mc Donald’s has such bad branch in such an important part of Barcelona. And not to mention how rude the guard was because I got into the place with an Ice Cream; he yelled at me telling me I couldn’t eat anything served by a different company. I had to throw my ice cream in order to order and the man kept looking at me angrily. I felt totally uncomfortable. It had never happened to me and I’m sure Spanish people is not that rude and he gave a bad impression of his own country and and terrible impression of Mc Donald’s.
author: Sebastián Guzmán

text: They didn't call out order, on the screen it went from preparing to nothing. Waited 5 minutes to be polite as they were very busy, tried to get one servers attention who completely blanked us then the second server shouted out very rudely that she had called the order three times...I was stood 2 meters away from her the whole time and she never did. Rude server's, cold food absolutely terrible McDonald's 👎. I have never given a bad review ever but totally disgusted with the service I received. The email address the company provided was an invalid email address so now would give less than one star if I could

text:
The place is a joke… I’ve lived in Barcelona for nearly 5 years and I don’t think I’ve ever had a hot portion of fries.

I know Spain is known for their laid back approach but my god I’d rather find better food in the trash outside.

Half the team is high and the other doesn’t give a damn about their responsibilities.

I know This won’t affect the ‘McDonald’s’ brand in any way but it doesn’t take a Michelin chef to cook fast food right.

Ps… wouldn’t give any stars if I could
